L158: ## Glossary
L159: 
L160: LTS
L161: 
L162: 
L163: A Long Term Support release is one guaranteed to be supported for a number of years. Neo4j 4.4 and 5.26 are LTS versions.
L164: 
L165: Aura
L166: 
L167: 
L168: 【86†Aura】 is Neo4j’s fully managed cloud service. It comes with both free and paid plans.
L169: 
L170: Cypher
L171: 
L172: 
L173: 【87†Cypher】 is Neo4j’s graph query language that lets you retrieve data from the database. It is like SQL, but for graphs.
L174: 
L175: APOC
L176: 【19†Awesome Procedures On Cypher (APOC)】 is a library of (many) functions that can not be easily expressed in Cypher itself.
L177: 
L178: Bolt
L179: 
L180: 
L181: 【38†Bolt】 is the protocol used for interaction between Neo4j instances and drivers. It listens on port 7687 by default.
L182: 
L183: ACID
L184: Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability (ACID) are properties guaranteeing that database transactions are processed reliably. An ACID-compliant DBMS ensures that the data in the database remains accurate and consistent despite failures.
L185: 
L186: eventual consistency
L187: 
L188: 
L189: A database is eventually consistent if it provides the guarantee that all cluster members will, at some point in time, store the latest version of the data.
